dct_description_sm: Data are associated with an incubation experiment designed to assess controls on microbial degradation of permafrost-origin dissolved organic matter. Data are in association with the following journal article submission:Erin MacDonald, E., Tank, S.E., Saidi-Mehrabad, A., Lanoil, B., and Lech, G. Coupled shifts in DOM composition and microbial community structure lead to variable biodegradation rates in thermokarst-affected permafrost stratigraphies
dct_title_s: Permafrost-origin biodegradation experiments on the Peel Plateau: Biogeochemical data
